blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
We show that multimodal models possess strong reasoning abilities and that an appropriate harness can unlock their potential to solve tasks across diverse interactive environments. We introduce VISTA , a visual harness that gives a general-purpose multimodal model long-horizon vision. VISTA allows the model to directly perceive the environment through visual observations and maintains a lossless visual memory that preserves past observations in their original form. The model can actively retrieve these observations and reorganize its visual input as it reasons. On ARC-AGI-3, VISTA improves Claude Opus 5.0’s Relative Human Action Efficiency score from 40.68
to a perfect 100.00, with the model completing all 25 public games using 57.4% fewer actions than first-time human participants. VISTA’s simple design also allows it to extend naturally to diverse visual environments with minimal adaptation. Across three additional benchmarks covering a diverse range of visual games and puzzles, it substantially outperforms baselines using the same underlying model with minimal harnesses. Our results highlight VISTA’s potential as a general-purpose visual harness for advancing multimodal agents in complex visual environments.
blocks.zh:
我们表明,多式联运模式具有强大的推理能力,适当的利用可以释放其潜力,在各种互动环境中解决各项任务。 我们介绍VISTA,一种视觉用具,可以提供通用多模式的长视距视野。 VISTA允许模型通过视觉观测直接感知环境,并保持了以原始形式保存过去的观测的无损视觉内存. 该模型可以积极取回这些观测结果,并按其原因重组其视觉输入. 在ARC-AGI-3上,VISTA从40.68提高克洛德·奥普斯5.0的相对人类行动效率分数.
完成所有25个公共游戏 动作比第一次人类参与者少57.4% ViSTA的简单设计也使得它能够自然地被扩展至多样的视觉环境并被最小的适应. 在涵盖各种视觉游戏和谜题的另外三项基准中,它使用同样的基本模型,用最小的绳子,大大超过基线。 我们的成果突出了VISTA作为在复杂的视觉环境中推进多式制剂的通用视觉工具的潜力。

blocks.en: We live in a dynamic, high-dimensional world. As humans, we perceive our surroundings, reason about what we observe, and act based on our understanding and past experience [ 56 , 48 ] . However, it remains unclear whether existing artificial intelligence (AI) systems have a similar ability to understand and interact robustly with the world, especially in unfamiliar environments.
blocks.zh: 我们生活在一个充满活力的高维世界中. 作为人类,我们看待我们的周围环境,了解我们所观察到的事物的理由,并根据我们的理解和过去的经验采取行动[56、48]。 然而,仍然不清楚的是,现有的人工智能系统是否具有类似的能力来了解世界并与世界进行强有力的互动,特别是在不熟悉的环境中。

blocks.en: To study this question, we use ARC-AGI-3 [ 5 ] , a suite of interactive visual games in which an agent needs to discover the rules and goals of unfamiliar worlds through interaction. This benchmark is typically approached as a language-based problem, with large language models (LLMs) receiving a textual or structured representation of the environment, as shown in Figure 1 a. Building on this setup, a common strategy is to use code-based methods that construct a executable world model using symbolic programs [ 62 , 39 , 11 , 25 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了研究这个问题,我们使用ARC-AGI-3 [5],这是一套交互式视觉游戏,其中代理商需要通过互动来发现陌生世界的规则和目标. 如图1a所示,这一基准通常被视为一个基于语言的问题,大型语言模型(LLMS)得到环境的文字或结构化代表。 在这个设置的基础上,一个共同的战略是使用基于代码的方法,用符号程序构建一个可执行的世界模型[62,39,11,25].

blocks.en: We instead reframe ARC-AGI-3 as a vision-based problem and address it using multimodal models. However, as illustrated in Figure 1 b, existing vision-language models (VLMs) typically encode each image once into visual representations [ 2 , 28 ] . These representations may not preserve the details needed as reasoning evolves. Moreover, earlier observations may be removed from the context or replaced by textual summaries to stay within the model’s context limit [ 29 , 36 , 27 ] . These limitations may constrain the models’ reasoning capabilities during long-horizon interactions.
blocks.zh: 相反,我们把ARC-AGI-3重新确定为一个基于愿景的问题,并采用多模式解决这一问题。 然而,如图1b所示,现有视觉语言模型(VLMs)通常将每个图像编码为一次可视化表示[2,28]. 随着推理的发展,这些表述可能无法保留所需的细节。 此外,可以将早先的意见从上下文中删除,或取而代之,取而代之的是文字摘要,以不超出模型上下文的限制[29、36、27]。 这些限制可能限制模型在长距离相互作用时的推理能力。

blocks.en:
To this end, we introduce VISTA , a visual harness that allows the model to actively reorganize its visual input during long-horizon interactions (Figure 1 c). The model receives visual observations of the environment that preserve the appearance and spatial relations of objects. It develops its understanding of the environment through free-form language reasoning [ 55 , 42 ] and uses this understanding to predict action outcomes and plan subsequent actions [ 59 ] .
Instead of relying solely on visual representations retained in the model’s context, which may be compressed, lossy, and insufficient for subsequent reasoning, VISTA maintains a lossless visual memory . This memory stores every frame returned by the environment, including intermediate animation frames, in its original form. The model can retrieve observations from this memory through visual inspection , selecting frames to compare and spatial regions to examine at different levels of detail based on its current reasoning needs [ 48 , 47 ] .
Figure 2 shows two example agent trajectories with VISTA, illustrating how observation, reasoning, inspection, and action are interleaved.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们引入了VISTA,一种可视化的拉带,可以让模型在长视线相互作用时积极重组其视觉输入(图1c). 该模型接收了保存了物体外观和空间关系的环境视觉观测. 它通过自由形式的语言推理来发展对环境的理解[55,42],并利用这种理解来预测行动结果并计划随后的行动[59].
VISTA不只依靠模型上下文中保留的可视化表现,这种表现可能是被压缩的,失去的,而且不足以进行随后的推理,而是保持一种无所失失的可视化记忆. . 这个内存以原始形式存储着环境返回的每一个帧,包括中间动画帧. 该模型可以通过视觉检查从这种内存中取回观测结果,选择比较的帧和空间区域,根据其目前的推理需要在不同的详细程度加以审查[48,47].
图2显示两个与VISTA的示例代理轨迹,说明观察,推理,检查,以及动作是如何互换的.

blocks.en:
With VISTA, Claude Opus 5.0 [ 3 ] completes all 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games with a Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) score of 100.00 with xhigh reasoning effort, using 57.4% fewer actions than the first-time human baseline. VISTA with GPT-5.6 Sol [ 33 ] likewise completes all 25 games, achieving an RHAE score of 99.00 with max reasoning effort. To our knowledge, VISTA is the first vision-based system to achieve perfect or near-perfect performance on ARC-AGI-3 without program synthesis. For comparison, the organizers’ official baselines, which also do not use programs, achieve RHAE scores of 40.68
with Opus 5.0 high and 13.33 with GPT-5.6 Sol max [ 7 , 34 ] .
blocks.zh:
随着VISTA,克洛德·奥普斯5.0 [3]完成了所有25个公开的ARC-AGI-3游戏,其相对人的行动效率(RHAE)得分为100.00分,并有高推理努力,使用动作比第一次人的基准少了57.4%. VSTA与GPT-5.6 Sol [33]同样完成所有25场比赛,以最大推理努力达到99.00的RHAE分. 据我们所知,VISTA是第一个在没有程序合成的情况下在ARC-AGI-3上实现完美或接近完美性能的基于视觉的系统. 比较一下,组织者的官方基线也并不使用程序,达到RHAE分数40.68
高5.0和高13.33高分为GPT-5.6 Sol max [7,34].

blocks.en: The simplicity of VISTA also allows it to extend naturally to other visual environments with minimal adaptation. We apply the same visual harness to 34 browser games from GameWorld [ 35 ] , 10 browser games from AI GameStore [ 60 ] , and 39 visual tracking problems from BabyVision [ 12 ] . Together, these benchmarks cover a wide range of games and visual reasoning tasks that require skills such as complex reasoning, spatial navigation, and strategic planning. GPT-5.6 Sol with VISTA substantially outperforms baselines that use the same model with minimal harnesses. It also outperforms the novice human baseline on GameWorld and the human median baseline on AI GameStore. Overall, these results demonstrate VISTA’s effectiveness across diverse visual environments and highlight visual harness design as an important direction for improving multimodal agents.
blocks.zh: VISTA的简单性也使得它能够以最小的适应性自然地扩展到其他视觉环境. 我们对来自GameWorld[35]的34个浏览器游戏,来自AI GameStore的10个浏览器游戏[60],以及来自BabyVision的39个视觉跟踪问题应用了同一种可视化的牵引. 这些基准加在一起,涵盖了需要复杂的推理,空间导航,战略规划等技能的广泛游戏和视觉推理任务. GPT-5.6 与VISTA相配的溶液大大超过使用同一型号并最小带的基线。 它还超越了GameWorld上的新人类基线和AI GameStore上人类中位基线. 总的来说,这些结果表明VISTA在各种视觉环境中的效力,并突出显示视觉用具设计是改进多式联运代理人的一个重要方向。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
ARC-AGI-1 [ 16 ] and ARC-AGI-2 [ 14 ] are benchmarks designed to evaluate abstract reasoning over static input–output grids [ 15 ] . Approaches to these benchmarks often use pretrained large language models [ 8 , 1 , 19 , 37 , 26 , 9 ] , recurrent models [ 50 , 23 ] , or vision-based models [ 22 ] .
ARC-AGI-3 [ 5 ] makes this setting interactive: an agent must explore novel environments, adapt continuously from its interactions, and take actions to achieve its goals [ 24 ] . Existing approaches to ARC-AGI-3 largely rely on program synthesis [ 62 , 25 , 11 , 39 , 40 ] , in which agents perceive the environment through textual or symbolic representations and abstract it into programs that can be executed, verified, and searched over to guide actions. While effective on ARC-AGI-3, these approaches rely on constructing explicit programmatic abstractions of the environment. As environments become more visually complex, representing their states, transition dynamics, and goal conditions with explicit programs may become increasingly difficult. In contrast, VISTA operates directly on visual observations and reasons in natural language.
blocks.zh:
ARC-AGI-1 [16]和ARC-AGI-2 [14]是用来评价抽象推理而不是静态输入-输出网格的基准[15]. 采用这些基准的方法往往使用经过预先培训的大型语言模型[8、1、19、37、26、9]、经常模型[50、23],或基于愿景的模型[22]。
ARC-AGI-3 [5] 使这种设定具有交互性:一个代理人必须探索出新的环境,不断从互动中适应,并采取行动来实现其目标[24]. 现有的ARC-AGI-3方法主要依赖于程序合成[62,25,11,39,40],其中代理人通过文字或符号表达来感知环境,并将其抽象为可以执行,验证和搜索以指导行动的程序. 虽然对ARC-AGI-3有效,但这些方法依赖于构建明确的环境方案抽象。 随着环境变得更加复杂,代表其状态,过渡动态和有明确方案的目标条件可能变得越来越困难。 相形之下,VISTA直接在自然语言的视觉观察和原因上运作.

blocks.en: Recent work has explored agents that interact with computers and graphical user interfaces to complete complex tasks. Existing approaches broadly differ in their observation space. Text-based approaches operate over structured representations of the interface, such as HTML, DOM trees, accessibility trees, or element identifiers, and use language models to reason over these representations and take symbolic actions [ 32 , 17 , 64 ] . Vision-based computer-use agents interact directly with screenshots and take grounded actions such as clicks, mouse movements, and keyboard inputs [ 13 , 57 , 38 , 52 , 30 ] . VISTA follows the vision-based paradigm: the agent reasons directly from visual observations rather than textual or symbolic representations of the environment. It focuses on a visual-centric harness for reasoning in interactive worlds and provides a simple interface for agents to observe and interact with the environment.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作探索了与计算机和图形用户界面互动的代理,以完成复杂的任务. 现有方法在观测空间方面大相径庭。 基于文本的方法在界面结构化的表示方式上运作,如HTML,DOM树,可访问性树,或元素标识符等,并使用语言模型对这些表示方式进行推理并采取象征性行动[32,17,64]. 基于视觉的计算机使用代理直接与截图互动,采取点击,鼠标移动等有底线动作,并进行键盘输入[13,57,38,52,30]. VISTA遵循了以视觉为基础的范式:由视觉观察直接引申而来,而不是环境的文字或象征性表现. 它侧重于在互动世界中以视觉为中心进行推理的用具,并提供了一个简单的界面,供代理人员观察并与环境互动.

blocks.en: Games have long served as testbeds for developing agents that learn to perceive, reason, and act in interactive environments. Classical approaches learn policies through reinforcement learning [ 31 , 43 , 44 ] or learn environment dynamics to support prediction and planning [ 41 , 21 ] . While these methods provide general learning algorithms, they typically require training a separate agent for each game. More recently, foundation models have enabled more general-purpose agents that operate in richer game environments. Voyager uses a large language model together with structured Minecraft observations and an executable skill library [ 51 ] , while JARVIS-1 incorporates visual observations and retrieves similar past experiences for planning in Minecraft [ 53 ] . Generalist agents such as SIMA and SIMA 2 [ 46 , 45 ] , Cradle [ 49 ] , and Game-TARS [ 54 ] further operate directly from visual observations across multiple environments. A central challenge in these systems is retaining information over long interaction horizons: prior agents typically maintain only a bounded visual context or selectively store and compress past experiences. VISTA instead preserves the complete visual interaction history losslessly and allows the agent to actively revisit arbitrary previous frames and regions during reasoning.
blocks.zh: 游戏长期以来一直充当开发人员在互动环境中学习感知、理性和行动的试验床。 古典方法通过强化学习学习政策[31,43,44]或学习环境动态以支持预测和规划[41,21]. 虽然这些方法提供了一般的学习算法,但它们通常需要为每场游戏培训一个单独的代理. 最近,基础模型使得更多的通用代理能够在更丰富的游戏环境中运作. Voyager使用一个大型语言模型,加上结构化的Minecraft观测和一个可执行技能库[51],而JARVIS-1则包含了视觉观测,并检索了类似的过去经验来进行Minecraft的规划[53]. 通用剂如SIMA和SIMA 2 [46,45],Cradle [49],和Game-TARS [54] 进一步直接通过跨多环境的视觉观测来操作. 这些系统中的一个中心挑战是在长期互动的地平线上保留信息:先前的代理通常只维持有限度的视觉环境,或者有选择地储存和压缩过去的经验。 而VISTA则保留了完整的视觉交互历史的白白地,并允许代理在推理时积极重温之前的任意帧和地区.

blocks.en: 3 VISTA: A Visual Harness
blocks.zh: 3 VISTA:视觉机能

blocks.en:
Figure 3: VISTA’s key design components and per-turn pipeline. We use ARC-AGI-3 as an example.
(a) Visual observations : The model receives rendered visual states.
(b) Lossless visual memory : Every returned frame is stored in its original form.
(c) Model-directed visual inspection : The model selects frames and regions to examine during reasoning.
(d) Per-turn pipeline : The agent observes, reasons, and acts, while each returned frame is preserved in visual memory. Revisiting past observations and updating notes are optional steps directed by the model.
blocks.zh:
图3:VISTA的关键设计部件和每回合输油管. 我们以ARC-AGI-3为例.
(a) 视觉观察: 模型接收到视觉状态
(b) 无损失的视觉记忆: 每个回放相框都以原始形式被存储.
(c) 模型式直观检查: 该模型选择了推理时要检查的帧和区域.
(d) 每回合输油管: 代理人观察,理由和行为,而每个返回的相框被保存在视觉记忆中. 重新审视过去的意见并更新说明是该模式指示的可选步骤。

blocks.en: VISTA lets the model directly perceive the environment through visual inputs. However, existing multimodal systems typically encode visual observations once and discard the raw inputs. As the context fills, these representations may be removed or replaced by textual summaries, and the model may not control what is retained. More importantly, the model may not know at encoding time which visual information will matter later: a representation sufficient at one stage may omit details required in subsequent reasoning steps.
blocks.zh: VISTA让模型通过视觉输入直接感知环境. 然而,现有的多模式系统通常一次编码可视观测,并丢弃原始输入。 随着上下文的填补,这些表述可能被去掉或被文字摘要所取而代之,模型可能无法控制保留的内容. 更重要的是,模型在编码时可能不知道哪些视觉信息日后会重要:一个阶段的表示足够了,可能会省略后续推理步骤所需的细节.

blocks.en: These limitations directly motivate the design of VISTA, which preserves original observations in a lossless visual memory and provides tools for the model to retrieve and inspect them during interaction. This allows the model to revisit visual evidence and reorganize its visual input as it reasons, without requiring all relevant information to be captured in the initial visual encoding and retained in the model’s context.
blocks.zh: 这些限制直接激发了VISTA的设计,它保存了原生观测在一无所失的视觉内存中,并为模型提供了在互动过程中取回并检查它们的工具. 这使得模型能够重新审视视觉证据,并按其理由重新组织其视觉输入,而不需要在初始视觉编码中捕捉出所有相关信息并保留在模型上下文中.

blocks.en: 3.1 Visual Harness Components
blocks.zh: 3.1 视觉动力组件

blocks.en: We introduce three key visual harness components: visual observations , which allows the agent to perceive the environment through rendered images; lossless visual memory , which preserves visual observations in their original form; and visual inspection , which allows the model to revisit visual evidence and examine details as needed. Together, these components provide the model with an explicit attention mechanism over the interaction history, allowing it to select which frames and regions to examine during reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了三个关键的视觉取景组件:视觉观察,它允许代理人通过渲染的图像来感知环境;无损失的视觉记忆,它保存了视觉观察的原始形式;和视觉检查,它允许模型重新审视视觉证据,并根据需要审查细节. 这些组成部分共同为模型提供了对互动历史的明确关注机制,使其能够选择哪些框架和区域在推理过程中进行审查。

blocks.en: The model receives visual observations from the environment (Figure. 3 a). These observations preserve the appearance and spatial relation of objects, allowing the model to use its learned visual priors to interpret and reason about the environment.
blocks.zh: 该模型从环境接收视觉观测(图. (单位:千美元) 这些观测保留了物体的外观和空间关系,使模型能够利用其所学到的视觉前科来解释和解释环境.

blocks.en: The harness stores every frame returned by the environment, including intermediate animation frames, in its original form (Figure. 3 b). Each frame is indexed by turn and frame number and remains available throughout the interaction, independently of what is retained in the model’s current context.
blocks.zh: 牵引装置以原始形式存储着环境返回的每个帧,包括中间动画帧(图. 页:1 每个框架都按转动和帧数编制索引,在整个互动过程中均可使用,与模型当前背景下保留的内容无关。

blocks.en: Building on the visual memory, we provide the agent with tools to actively inspect visual information in space and across time (Figure 3 c). In space , it can request an enlarged view of any rectangular region from the original frame, allowing it to examine fine-grained details that may be difficult to perceive in the full image. Across time , it can retrieve and inspect multiple frames from arbitrary earlier turns to revisit past visual evidence, compare states, and replay how an action unfolded through its intermediate animation frames. At each turn, the model is free to decide whether to inspect its visual memory and which frames or regions to examine.
blocks.zh: 在视觉内存的基础上,我们向特工提供了在空间和跨时间积极检查视觉信息的工具(图3 c. 在太空中,它可以要求从原始框架扩大任何长方形区域的范围,使其能够审查可能难以从整个图像中看出的精细细节。 在一段时间内,它可以检索和检查先前任意转向的多帧,以重新审视过去的视觉证据,比较状态,并重放动作如何通过中间动画帧展开. 每个转弯时,模型可以自由决定是否检查其视觉内存,以及检查哪个帧或区域.

blocks.en: 3.2 Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.2 管道

blocks.en:
In our pipeline, the model and the harness interact through a multi-turn conversation (Figure 2 ). The harness is purely mechanical and does not involve any trained model: it executes tool calls requested by the model, returns outputs such as images or pixel values, and reports errors for invalid requests.
The model reasons over these outputs and issues its next request to the harness if needed.
blocks.zh:
在我们的管道中,模型和绳子通过多回合对话(图2)相互作用。 牵引装置纯粹是机械的,不涉及任何训练有素的模型:它执行模型所要求的工具调用,返回图像或像素值等输出,报告无效请求出错.
模型对这些产出提出了理由,并在需要时向用户提出了下一次要求。

blocks.en: A single agent interacts with each game throughout the run. Each game turn may include multiple exchanges with the harness before the agent executes one game action (Figure 3 d). At the start of a turn, the agent receives the current visual state and available actions. It can also consult two notes that it maintains: GUIDE.md , which records its understanding of the game and information that may remain useful across levels, and WORKING.md , which serves as a scratchpad for the current state. Through inspect , the agent can revisit earlier observations, including intermediate animation frames produced by its previous actions. It can also use read_pixels to examine pixel values within a selected region. Consulting the notes and using the inspection tools are optional and left to the agent’s decision.
blocks.zh: 在整个运行过程中,一个单一代理与每个游戏进行互动. 每个游戏转弯可能包括在代理执行一款游戏动作之前与被子进行多处交换(图3 d). 在回合开始时,代理接收当前可视状态和可用的动作. 也可以参考它所保持的两种注释:Guide.md 记录了它对于游戏的理解和可能在各个关卡中仍然有用的信息;Working.md 为当前状态提供抓取. 通过检查,代理可以重温更早的观察,包括之前的行动所制作的中间动画帧. 它也可以使用 read_像素来检查所选区域内的像素值. 咨询说明和使用检查工具是可选的,由代理人决定。

blocks.en: The agent uses free-form language to reason and plan. It predicts the outcome of its planned action, revises its notes to reflect its updated understanding of the environment, and calls play to execute the chosen action and advance to the next game turn. When its context approaches the limit, the agent writes a concise handoff summary and resumes from the current state in a fresh context. Its notes ( GUIDE.md and WORKING.md ), visual memory, and action history remain available.
blocks.zh: 代理人使用自由形式语言进行理性和计划. 它预测其计划行动的结果,修订其说明以反映其对环境的最新了解,并号召游戏执行所选择的行动并推进到下个游戏回合. 当上下文接近极限时,代理写出简明的交接摘要,并在新的上下文中从当前状态恢复. 它的笔记(Guide.md和Working.md),视觉记忆,以及行动历史仍然可用.

blocks.en: Every game uses the same interface and short prompt as shown in Appendix A.5 . The available tools (e.g., inspect , read_pixels , and play ), together with their pseudocode and corresponding descriptions are provided to the agent, as shown in Appendix A.4 ).
blocks.zh: 每款游戏都使用附录A.5所示的相同界面和短促. 如附录A.4所示,现有工具(例如检查、读取-像素和播放)及其伪码和相应说明提供给代理人。

blocks.en: 4 VISTA on ARC-AGI-3
blocks.zh: 关于ARC-AGI-3的4个VISTA

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en:
ARC-AGI-3 [ 5 ] consists of interactive visual games whose rules and objectives are not provided explicitly. We evaluate on the 25 public games. At each step, the agent observes the current visual state, selects an available action, and uses the resulting observation to infer object roles, transition rules, hidden states, and possible goals. Each game contains multiple levels that share underlying mechanics while introducing new concepts, objects, layouts, or constraints. The agent therefore needs to retain and apply previously inferred knowledge across levels while continually adapting its understanding through interaction.
Figure 4 shows an example agent trajectory.
blocks.zh:
ARC-AGI-3 [5] 由互动视觉游戏组成,其规则和目标没有明确提供. 我们评价了25个公开游戏 在每个步骤上,代理观察当前可视状态,选择可用的动作,并利用由此而来的观察来推断对象角色,过渡规则,隐藏状态,以及可能的目标. 每款游戏包含多个关卡,在引入新概念,对象,布局或约束的同时共享基础力学. 因此,代理人需要保留和运用先前推断的知识,同时通过互动不断调整其理解。
图4显示了一个实例代理轨迹。

blocks.en: Performance is measured by Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) [ 4 ] , which compares an agent’s action efficiency with that of first-time human players. A completed level receives 100% credit when its action count matches the human baseline, up to 115% when it uses fewer actions, and partial credit when it uses more actions. Unfinished levels receive zero credit. Later levels receive greater weight, and each game score is capped by the weighted fraction of levels completed. See Appendix A.3 for details.
blocks.zh: 性能通过相对人类行动效率(RHAE)[4]来衡量,它比较了代理人的行动效率与第一次人类玩家的行动效率. 完成水平在行动量与人类基线相符时获得100%的信贷,在行动量较少时获得115%的信贷,在行动量较多时获得部分信贷。 未完成水平获得零信用. 后来的关卡获得更大的分量,每个游戏分数被完成关卡的加权分数所封顶. 详情见附录A.3。

blocks.en:
We instantiate VISTA with two general-purpose, closed-weight multimodal model backends commonly used in prior work. Each backend is evaluated independently under the same interaction protocol.
We use Claude Opus 5.0 [ 3 ] run with extra-high reasoning effort through the Claude Code CLI and GPT-5.6 Sol [ 33 ] run with max reasoning effort through the Codex CLI.
blocks.zh:
我们用前作中常用的两个通用的封闭式多式模型后端,即时使用VISTA. 每个后端都在同一互动协议下独立评价.
我们用克洛德·奥普斯5.0 [3]通过克洛德代码CLI和GPT-5.6 Sol [33]通过克洛德代码CLI进行超高推理努力跑出最大推理.

blocks.zh: 4.2 结果

With Claude Opus 5.0, VISTA achieves a perfect RHAE score of 100.00, matching other state-of-the-art systems. It uses 7,302 actions in total, 57.4% fewer than the human reference of 17,135 actions.

blocks.en:
Most of the compared systems come from concurrent work. These systems typically represent observations as text-based numerical grids and often reason using a code-based world model: the agent abstracts the environment into symbolic programs that can be executed and checked during exploration.
To our knowledge, VISTA is the first system to achieve perfect or near-perfect performance on ARC-AGI-3 without program synthesis . For comparison, the same model scores only 40.68 under the official implementation.
In Figure 6 , we also compare textual grids with our default image observations. We find that visual observations achieve comparable performance with fewer actions while using significantly fewer tokens.
blocks.zh:
比较的系统大多来自同时工作。 这些系统典型地代表了作为以文字为基础的数字网格的观测,并经常使用以代码为基础的世界模型来说明理由:代理将环境归纳为在探索中可以执行和检查的象征性程序.
据我们所知,VISTA是第一个在没有程序合成的情况下在ARC-AGI-3上实现完美或接近完美性能的系统. 作为比较,同一模式在正式实施下只得分为40.68分.
在图6中,我们还比较了文字网格和默认图像观测. 我们发现,视觉观察以较少的动作实现相似的性能,同时使用更少的符号.

blocks.en:
We compare GPT-5.6 Sol under progressively richer harness configurations in Figure 5 . The official implementation uses textual grids and has a reported RHAE score of 13.33 with 10,619 actions [ 7 , 34 ] . Replacing these textual grids with rendered PNG images (i) increases the score to 47.32, demonstrating the importance of visual observations. The low action count is partly due to runs reaching the action or time limit before completing the games, as suggested by the low completion rate in this configuration. Increasing the action and time limits improves the score to 51.66 (ii).
In (iii), we introduce a minimal agent harness that maintains a continuous conversation and uses native compaction to continue beyond its context limit, improving the score to 65.82. Configuration (iv) adds two note files, GUIDE.md and WORKING.md , along with instructions encouraging the agent to build a compact and revisable model of the game, further improving the score to 70.05 (see the prompt in Appendix A.5 ). Finally, configurations (v)–(vi) introduce VISTA’s key visual harness components: adding lossless visual memory and model-directed inspection (v) improves the score to 94.10, while exact pixel readout (vi), which provides numerical RGB values for selected pixels, completes the VISTA harness and increases the score to 99.00.
blocks.zh:
我们比较GPT-5.6 Sol在图5中日益丰富的带状配置。 官方实施使用文字网格,并报告RHAE得分为13.33分,有10,619个动作 [7,34]. 用渲染出PNG图像来取代这些文字网格(一)将分数提高到47.32,显示了视觉观测的重要性. 动作计数低的部分原因是在完成游戏前运行到动作或时限,这个配置的完成率低就说明了这一点. 增加动作和时间限制将分数提高到 51.66 (二).
在(iii)中,我们引入了一种最小的代理牵引装置,能够保持连续的对话,并使用本土紧凑来继续超越上下文的限制,将分数提高到65.82. 配置 (四)增加了两个注释文件"Guide.md"和"World.md",以及鼓励代理商构建紧凑可重视游戏模式的指令,将分数进一步提高到70.05(见附录A.5中的提示). 最后,配置(v)-(vi)引入了VISTA的关键视觉取用带组件:加入无损视觉内存并进行模型定向检查(v)将分数提高到94.10,而精确的像素读取(vi)则为所选像素提供数字RGB值,完成VISTA取用带,将分数提高到99.00.

(a) An example game state shown as a flattened text grid and a 2D image; the displayed text grid is cropped from the full 64 × 64 64\times 64 grid. (b) RHAE, total actions across the 25 games, and average token usage per game for the two observation representations.
blocks.zh: 图6:ARC-AGI-3上的观察表述比较. (a) 显示为平面文本网格和2D图像的游戏实例状态;显示的文本网格从完整的64×64-times 64网格被裁剪出。 (b) RHAE,横跨25个游戏的总动作,以及两款观察演示每款游戏的平均象征性使用.

blocks.en: Prior approaches to ARC-AGI-3 commonly represent each frame as a textual grid, encoding observations as rows of integer color indices [ 62 , 39 , 11 , 25 ] . In contrast, VISTA reasons directly from rendered images. We ablate this design choice by replacing VISTA’s image observations with textual grids while keeping the rest of the harness unchanged. As shown in Figure 6 , using textual grids maintains comparable performance but slightly increases the total number of actions. Textual grids are also substantially more token-intensive: a 64 × 64 64\times 64 grid requires roughly 4,000 tokens, compared with approximately 308 image tokens for our default 512 × 512 512\times 512 observation. Token usage per game is 71.9M with textual grids and 30.7M with image observations.
blocks.zh: 先前的ARC-AGI-3方法通常将每个框架作为文字网格来表示,编码观察作为整数色指数行 [62,39,11,25]. 相比之下,VISTA则直接从渲染出图像来解释原因. 我们放弃了这种设计选择,用文字网格取代了VISTA的图像观察,同时保持其余的绳子不变。 如图6所示,使用文字网格保持可比较的性能,但略有增加动作总数. 文字网格也大大地增加了符号密集度:一个64×64 64\times 64格格需要大约4000个符号,而我们默认的512×512 512\times 512的观察则需要大约308个图像符号. 每个游戏的托肯用法为71.9M有文字网格,30.7M有图像观测.

blocks.en: We vary VISTA’s maximum context size, which determines how much interaction history is retained before the agent compacts its history and resumes in a fresh context. As shown in Figure 7 a, the default 200K setting achieves the highest RHAE of 99.00. Larger contexts are substantially more expensive: 780K consumes 105.7M tokens per game, compared with 30.7M at 200K. Reducing the context to 100K lowers RHAE by only 0.4 while roughly halving token usage, showing that the harness remains effective even with shorter contexts.
blocks.zh: 我们更改了VISTA的最大上下文大小,它决定了在代理压缩其历史并在新的上下文中恢复之前保留多少互动历史。 如图7a所示,默认的200K设置达到99.00的最高RHAE. 更大的上下文价格要高得多:780K每款游戏消耗105.7M令牌,而200K时消耗30.7M. 将上下文降低到100K将RHAE只降低0.4,而将象征性使用量大致减半,表明即使上下文较短,这种取材仍然有效。

blocks.en: We vary the input image scale to study the trade-off between visual resolution and image token usage. The 2 × 2\times , 4 × 4\times , 8 × 8\times , and 16 × 16\times scales correspond to 128, 256, 512, and 1,024 pixels per side, requiring approximately 20, 77, 308, and 1,229 image tokens per frame, respectively. As shown in Figure 7 b, 4 × 4\times uses 75 75 % fewer image tokens than the default 8 × 8\times while achieving comparable performance. Reducing the scale to 2 × 2\times degrades performance, while increasing it to 16 × 16\times provides no additional benefit and costs more tokens per game, likely because the extra image tokens consume context without improving visual reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们改变输入图像尺度,以研究视觉分辨率和图像符号使用之间的取舍. 2×2相,4×4相,8×8相,16×16相,相等平面尺度分别对应128相,256相,512相和1,024相等像素,每帧分别需要约20相,77相,308相和1,229相相相. 如图7b所示,4×4\时间使用75个75%的图像符号比默认的8×8\时间少,同时实现可比较的性能. 将比例降为2×2\times会降低性能,而将比例降为16×16\times则不会为每场游戏带来额外的好处并花费更多的代币,这可能是因为额外的图像代币消耗上下文而不改进视觉推理.

We compare VISTA against the official implementation using a minimal harness, as well as a VISTA variant with inspect and read_pixels removed. VISTA’s visual harness leads to a significant performance improvement.
blocks.zh: 图8:ARC-AGI-3使用开放式GLM-5.3 Flash 320B模型的结果. 我们把VISTA与使用最低限度的牵引装置的正式实施以及VISTA的变体进行比较,检查和读取了像素。 VISTA的视觉用具导致显著的性能改善.

blocks.en:
We additionally evaluate VISTA with the open-weight backend GLM-5.3 Flash 320B [ 20 , 63 ] . This gives a fully open-source and reproducible system. Figure 8 compares the RHAE scores of three configurations: the organizers’ official implementation, which we ran with its minimal harness; VISTA without the visual harness, which removes only inspect and read_pixels tools; and full VISTA.
VISTA achieves an RHAE score of 66.93, substantially outperforming the official baseline. These results further support VISTA’s effectiveness across model backends.
blocks.zh:
我们用开放式后端GLM-5.3 Flash 320B [20,63] 对VISTA进行额外评价. 这提供了一个完全开源和可复制的系统。 图8比较了RHAE三种配置的分数:组织者的官方执行,我们用它最小的绳子运行;VISTA没有视觉的绳子,它只去除检查和读取_像素工具;和完整的VISTA.
VISTA取得了66.93分的RHAE分数,大大超过了官方基准. 这些结果进一步支持了VISTA跨模型后端的有效性.

blocks.en: Figure 9: 3D renderings of ARC-AGI-3. (a) Two games rendered in 3D. (b) RHAE scores and total action counts for VISTA using 2D images and 3D renderings.
blocks.zh: 图9: 三维渲染ARC-AGI-3. (a) 三维渲染出两款游戏. (b) RHAE分数和使用2D图像和3D渲染的VISTA总动作计数。

blocks.en: We evaluate VISTA under more challenging visual conditions by rendering the same games in 3D. As shown in Figure 9 , the model achieves an RHAE score of 84.12 with 20,640 actions. Although VISTA requires substantially more interaction with these renderings than with the default 2D images, it still achieves strong performance and outperforms official textual baselines by a large margin. These results demonstrate its robustness to more complex visual representations and its ability to generalize beyond 2D representations. As we further show in Section 5 , VISTA remains effective across a broader range of visual environments, including 3D games.
blocks.zh: 我们在更具挑战性的视觉条件下通过在3D中渲染同一种游戏来评价VISTA. 如图9所示,该模型以20,640个动作实现"RHAE"的84.12分. 虽然VISTA要求与这些渲染比默认的2D图像要多得多的互动,但仍能实现强性能并大大超过官方文本基线. 这些结果表明它坚固到更复杂的视觉表现,并有能力概括到2D表现之外. 正如我们在第5节所进一步显示的那样,VISTA在更广泛的视觉环境中依然有效,包括3D游戏.

blocks.en: 4.4 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 定性分析

blocks.en:
The key components of the VISTA harness are lossless visual memory and visual inspection, which allow the agent to revisit stored visual information at any point during interaction. These components provide a form of explicit attention over interaction history. Here, we show qualitative examples of how agents benefit from this re-attention mechanism.
Figure 10 a illustrates re-attention across space and time. The agent revisits earlier frames to recover information that is no longer visible in its current observation. In this example, it inspects frames from different points in the trajectory and integrates their information to reconstruct the overall map.
Figure 10 b illustrates re-attention to local visual details. The agent selectively zooms into a small region of a stored observation to determine a block’s orientation, which is difficult to see clearly in the full 512 × 512 512\times 512 frame.
Together, these examples illustrate two complementary forms of re-attention enabled by lossless visual memory: integrating visual evidence across the interaction history and inspecting local details at the granularity required by the current task.
blocks.zh:
VISTA带的关键组件是无损的视觉内存和视觉检查,这使得代理在互动过程中的任意时刻可以重温所储存的视觉信息. 这些组成部分提供了一种明确关注互动历史的形式。 在这里,我们展示了代理人如何从这种再接纳机制中受益的定性实例。
图10a显示跨空间和跨时间的重复使用。 毒剂重温了更早的帧来取回在当前观察中已经看不到的信息. 在这个例子中,它从轨迹的不同点检查帧并整合它们的信息来重建总体地图.
图10b显示重新注意当地视觉细节。 该剂选择性地放大成一个存储观测的小区域,以确定一个块的方向,这在完整的512×512 512\times 512帧中很难清楚地看到.
这些例子共同说明了无损视觉内存所促成的两种互补的再注意形式:将视觉证据整合到互动历史中,并检查当前任务所需的颗粒性局部细节.

blocks.en:
Figure 10: Model-directed use of visual memory. (a) Inspect across space and time: after the board resets, the model retrieves four frames from the preceding 22 turns in a single inspect call to reconstruct the map.
(b) Inspect local visual details: the model uses inspect to zoom in on three small blocks by about 13 × 13\times . The enlarged views reveal which side of each block carries a purple marker, allowing the model to identify each block’s orientation.
blocks.zh:
图10:模型定向使用视觉内存. (a) 横跨空间和时间的检查:在棋盘重新投放后,模型从前22个转弯取回了4个帧,用一次检查呼叫来重建地图。
(b) 国家 透视本地视觉细节:该模型使用检查来放大到三个小块上大约13×13\时. 扩大的视图显示每个区块的哪一边有一个紫色标记,使模型能够识别每个区块的方向.

blocks.en: 5 General Visual Environments
blocks.zh: 5 一般视觉环境

blocks.en: Figure 11: Evaluation environments and results. Top : examples from the three benchmarks. GameWorld and AI GameStore are interactive, while BabyVision is static. Bottom : VISTA with GPT-5.6 Sol compared with human players and the official implementation using a minimal harness. We report success rate and progress for GameWorld, the geometric mean of human-normalized scores (human median = 100 =100 ) for AI GameStore, and accuracy for BabyVision. The dashed line marks the best previously reported result.
blocks.zh: 图11:评价环境和成果。 上:三个基准的例子。 GameWorld和AI GameStore是互动的,而Baby Vision则是静态的. 下部:带有GPT-5.6的VISTA 与人类玩家和官方执行相比,Sol使用最小的绳索. 我们报告GameWorld的成功率和进展,AI GameStore的人类常态化分数的几何平均值(人中位数=100=100)和Baby Vision的精确度. 虚线标志着过去所报告的最佳结果。

blocks.en:
VISTA’s general-purpose design allows us to naturally apply the same visual harness to other benchmarks with minimal adaptation. We evaluate VISTA on two interactive game benchmarks: GameWorld [ 35 ] and AI GameStore [ 60 ] . We also evaluate on a static visual reasoning benchmark, BabyVision [ 12 ] , to examine the role of visual inspection without interaction with a dynamic environment.
For each benchmark, we compare VISTA with the official implementation using the same model. We also report human performance and the best previously reported result as references. See Appendices A.3 and A.6 for details. Figure 11 shows an overview of these environments. Appendix Figure 14 shows example VISTA trajectories on both interactive and static tasks.
blocks.zh:
VISTA的通用设计使我们能够自然地将同样的视觉用具应用到其他基准上,但适应性最小。 我们用两个互动游戏基准来评价VISTA:GameWorld [35]和AI GameStore [60]. 我们还对静态视觉推理基准"Baby Vision [12]"进行评估,以审查视觉检查的作用,而不与动态环境互动.
就每个基准而言,我们使用同一模式,将VISTA与正式实施进行比较。 我们还报告人类业绩以及先前报告的最佳结果。 详见附录A.3和A.6。 图11概述了这些环境。 附录图14显示了关于互动和静态任务的例子VISTA轨迹.

blocks.en: 5.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 设置

blocks.en:
GameWorld [ 35 ] contains 34 browser games with 170 tasks across five genres: arcade, platformer, puzzle, runner, and simulation. The agent receives only the official task prompt, available controls, and screenshots. We evaluate VISTA using the computer-use interface, through which the agent interacts with the games directly via keyboard and mouse actions.
We report success rate (SR), defined as the fraction of the 170 tasks completed, and progress (PG), which also credits partial completion. Both metrics are computed by the benchmark’s official evaluator.
blocks.zh:
GameWorld [35] 包含34个浏览器游戏,共有170个任务,跨越了5个流派:街机,平台,谜题,跑步和模拟. 代理只接收官方任务提示,可用控件和截图. 我们使用计算机使用接口来评价VISTA,通过该接口,代理直接通过键盘和鼠标动作与游戏互动.
我们报告成功率(SR),即已完成的170项任务的一小部分,以及进度(PG),后者也算作部分完成。 这两个衡量标准都由基准的官方评价员计算。

blocks.en:
AI GameStore [ 60 ] contains 10 public browser games. The agent receives only the public game description, controls, and visual observations. Through interaction, it must infer the game dynamics and determine how to achieve the objectives.
Each game uses its own scoring system. Following the benchmark’s official protocol, we normalize each raw score so that the corresponding published human median equals 100, then compute the geometric mean of the normalized scores across the ten games.
blocks.zh:
AI GameStore [60] 包含10个公共浏览器游戏. 代理只接收公开的游戏描述,控制和视觉观察. 通过互动,它必须推断出游戏动态,并确定如何实现目标.
每款游戏都使用自己的评分系统. 根据基准的官方协议,我们把每个原始得分正常化,这样相应的公布的人类中位数就等于100,然后计算十场比赛中正常得分的几何平均值。

blocks.en: BabyVision [ 12 ] contains 388 static visual reasoning tasks across 22 subclasses. Each task consists of a single static image and a question. The agent perceives the image and can decide which visual regions to inspect and which individual pixels to read. We evaluate on the 39 questions from two Visual Tracking subtypes: 20 maze tasks and 19 connecting-lines tasks. We report accuracy across these tasks.
blocks.zh: Baby Vision [12] 包含有跨22个子类的388个静态视觉推理任务. 每项任务由一个单一的静态图像和一个问题组成. 代理可以感知到图像,可以决定检查的视觉区域以及阅读的单个像素. 我们对来自两个视觉跟踪子类型的39个问题进行评估:20个迷宫任务和19个连接线任务. 我们报告这些任务的准确性。

blocks.en: 5.2 Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 结果

blocks.en: Figure 11 shows our results. Across all three benchmarks, VISTA consistently outperforms the corresponding baselines with minimal harness. VISTA also exceeds the reported performance of fresh human players on GameWorld and AI GameStore. On BabyVision, where observations are static and no interaction history is involved, VISTA improves accuracy from 41.0% with the official implementation to 63.2%, highlighting the benefit of visual inspection, which allows the agent to selectively inspect regions within a single image.
blocks.zh: 图11显示了我们的成果。 在所有三项基准中,VISTA始终以最低的利用率超过相应的基线。 VISTA也超过了GameWorld和AI GameStore上报道的新鲜人类玩家的表现. 在Baby Vision上,观察是静态的,没有互动历史,VISTA将精度从41.0%随正式实施提升到63.2%,突出视觉检查的好处,这使得代理商可以有选择地在一幅图像中检查区域.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 限制

blocks.en: We acknowledge that the models’ existing capabilities remain a key factor in this success, and VISTA provides a simple but effective way to elicit them [ 58 , 18 , 61 ] . Its substantial gains over the baselines highlight visual harness design as a direction that complements model improvements. Additionally, because the models we use were released after the public benchmarks, we cannot rule out the possibility that these games were included in their training data. Evaluation on novel games, such as those in the private set of ARC-AGI-3 [ 5 ] , would provide a stronger test of our system’s generalization.
blocks.zh: 我们承认,这些模型的现有能力仍然是取得这一成功的关键因素,而VISTA为吸引这些模型提供了简单而有效的途径[58、18、61]。 它在基线方面取得的显著进展突出表明,视觉利用设计是补充模型改进的一个方向。 此外,由于我们使用的模型是在公共基准之后发布的,我们不能排除这些游戏被包括在他们的训练数据中的可能性. 对小游戏的评价,例如ARC-AGI-3[5]的私人游戏集,将更有力地检验我们系统的普及。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
VISTA shows that a simple visual harness can unlock the potential of existing multimodal models to complete complex tasks in interactive visual environments. It provides the model with raw visual observations, preserves them in a lossless visual memory, and allows the model to revisit past visual experience at the original level of detail during interaction. We show that this simple design is sufficient for the agent to complete all 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games with a perfect score. The same harness extends naturally to other environments covering a diverse set of visual games and puzzles, with minimal adaptation.
Overall, VISTA’s simple design and strong performance across diverse benchmarks suggest its potential as a general-purpose harness for tasks beyond games. Future work could evaluate VISTA on more complex and realistic tasks, such as embodied tasks in environments that more closely resemble the physical world [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh:
VISTA显示,简单的可视化拉带可以释放出现有多模式模式在互动可视环境下完成复杂任务的潜力. 它为模型提供了原始的视觉观测,保存在无损失的视觉内存中,并允许模型在互动过程中以原始的详细程度重温过去的视觉体验. 我们显示,这种简单的设计足以让代理完成所有25个公开的ARC-AGI-3游戏,并获得完美的分数. 同样的套接力自然地延伸至其他环境,覆盖了多样的视觉游戏和谜题,适应度也很低.
总体而言,VISTA的简单设计和跨越不同基准的强效表现表明,它有可能成为游戏以外任务的通用工具。 今后的工作可以就更为复杂和现实的任务对VISTA进行评价,例如在更接近物理世界的环境中体现的任务[10]。

blocks.zh: 附录A 实验细节

blocks.en: A.1 Baselines: Official Implementations
blocks.zh: A.1 基线:正式执行

blocks.en: For each benchmark, we use the authors’ reported results when available. Otherwise, we rerun the official implementation following the reported agent configuration. We use the models through their subscription-based CLI interfaces (Claude Opus 5.0 through the Claude Code CLI and GPT-5.6 Sol through the Codex CLI) rather than through direct API calls. For the open-weight GLM-5.3 Flash 320B , we also use the Codex CLI, with GLM as the model backend.
blocks.zh: 对于每个基准,我们使用作者报告的结果。 否则,我们将在报告代理配置之后重新运行正式执行. 我们通过基于订阅的CLI接口(Claude Opus 5.0通过Claude Code CLI和GPT-5.6 Sol通过Codex CLI)使用这些模型,而不是通过直接API调用. 对于开口重量的GLM-5.3 Flash 320B,我们也使用Codex CLI,以GLM为模型后端.

blocks.en:
On ARC-AGI-3, the organizers’ minimal agent interface represents each observation as a textual grid and provides a list of available actions. When an action produces multiple frames, it retains up to seven intermediate states. It maintains a 175K-token context window; once the window is exceeded, the earliest turns are discarded, so the agent has no long-term memory. We limit the number of actions per game to 2,000 for Claude Opus 5.0 and GPT-5.6 Sol, and to 3,000 for GLM-5.3 Flash 320B.
Table 1 reports the organizers’ published results for Claude Opus 5.0 and GPT-5.6 Sol [ ARC Prize Foundation, 2026c , ARC Prize Foundation, 2026d , OpenAI, 2026b ] . Figure 8 shows our results for GLM-5.3 Flash 320B, obtained using the original codebase.
blocks.zh:
在ARC-AGI-3上,组织者的最小代理界面作为文字网格代表了每个观测,并提供了可用的动作列表. 当一个动作产生多帧时,它保留了多达七个中间状态. 它维持一个175K-token上下文窗口;一旦超过窗口,会丢弃最早的转弯,因此代理机没有长期内存. 我们把克洛德·奥普斯5.0和GPT-5.6 Sol的每场比赛动作次数限制在2000个,GLM-5.3 Flash 320B的动作次数限制在3000个.
表1报告了Claude Opus 5.0和GPT-5.6 Sol组织者公布的结果[ARC奖基金会,2026c;ARC奖基金会,2026d;OpenAI,2026b]. 图8显示了我们使用原始代码库获取的GLM-5.3 Flash 320B的结果.

blocks.en: On GameWorld [ Ouyang et al., 2026 ] , we reproduce the official computer-use agent with GPT-5.6 Sol, following the official interaction and evaluation protocols. The agent operates directly from screenshots using keyboard and mouse actions, with each model request including the screenshots, reasoning, and actions from the two preceding steps. Each task is limited to 100 actions.
blocks.zh: 在GameWorld[Oyang等,2026]上,我们按照官方互动和评价协议,以GPT-5.6 Sol复制了官方计算机使用代理. 代理直接通过使用键盘和鼠标动作的截图操作,每个模型请求包括截图,推理,以及前两个步骤的动作. 每项任务仅限于100个行动。

blocks.en: On AI GameStore [ Ying et al., 2026 ] , we reproduce the official evaluation loop. The agent makes one decision per game second, receiving five frames sampled at 0.2 s intervals. Each model request includes only these current frames as visual input, together with the scratchpad, action, and result from the preceding decision. A run has 120 decisions, with the game paused during model inference.
blocks.zh: 在AI GameStore [Ying等, 2026]上,我们转载了官方的评价圈. 代理商每游戏第二秒做出一个决定,接收以0.2分间隔抽取的5个帧. 每个模型请求仅包括这些作为视觉输入的电流框架,以及抓取板,动作,以及由上个决定产生的. 跑步有120个决定,游戏在模型推论期间暂停.

blocks.en: On BabyVision [ Chen et al., 2026 ] , the baseline is the official one-shot setting: the model receives the image and question in a single request and answers without additional visual inspection or interaction. We extract the final answer using the benchmark’s reference code.
blocks.zh: 在Baby Vision [Chen等,2026]上,基线为一发正式设定:模型在单一请求和回答中接收图像和问题,而无需额外的视觉检查或互动. 我们用基准参考代码提取最后答案。

blocks.en: A.2 Ablation Details
blocks.zh: A.2 细目

blocks.en: We incrementally modify the official ARC-AGI-3 implementation to examine the contributions of VISTA’s components (Figure 5 ). The official implementation accesses the model through the API, whereas our experiments use the Codex CLI through the subscription interface. Therefore, the officially reported result should be treated as an external reference. However, we use the same underlying model and reasoning effort to match the official configuration as closely as possible. All configurations (i)–(vi) use the same model access interface and are directly comparable with one another.
blocks.zh: 我们逐步修改ARC-AGI-3的正式实施,以审查VISTA各组成部分的贡献(图5)。 官方执行通过API访问该模型,而我们的实验则通过订阅界面使用Codex CLI. 因此,应将官方报告的结果作为外部参考。 然而,我们使用同样的基本模式和推理努力来尽可能地与官方配置相匹配. 所有配置(一)-(六)使用相同的模式访问界面,彼此直接可比.

blocks.en: (i): Image observations. We first replace the textual grid observations with rendered images. This leads to an RHAE score of 47.32, demonstrating the importance of visual observations. We hypothesize that improved token efficiency contributes to this gain: each image observation requires approximately 308 image tokens, compared with roughly 4K text tokens for an equivalent 64 × 64 64\times 64 textual grid. A request containing seven frames therefore uses roughly 28K tokens for textual observations, compared with about 2.2K for images. Image observations leave more of the model’s limited context window available for reasoning within each request.
blocks.zh: (一) 国家 图片观察. 我们首先用渲染的图像取代文字网格观测。 这导致RHAE得分47.32分,证明了视觉观测的重要性. 我们假设提高的符号效率有助于这一收益:每次图像观察需要大约308个图像符号,而大约4K文本符号则需要相当的64×64 64\times 64文本网格. 因此,包含7个框架的请求使用大约28K个符号进行文字观察,而图像则使用大约2.2K个。 图像观察会留下更多的模型有限的上下文窗口,用于在每次请求中进行推理.

blocks.en: (i) → \rightarrow (ii): Increased action and time limits. The official implementation uses a per-section action limit of 5 × 5\times the human baseline and a 12-hour runtime limit. We find that many runs terminate upon reaching these limits, leaving the games unfinished. We therefore increase the limits to 2,000 total actions and 48 hours per game, improving the RHAE score to 51.66. We do not observe substantial additional benefits from further increasing these limits.
blocks.zh: (一) ~ 恰到好处(二):增加行动和时限。 正式实施采用每节动作限制5×5正时为人的基准和12小时运行时间限制. 我们发现,许多比赛在达到这些极限后结束,使比赛没有完成。 因此,我们把限制提高到了2 000个总动作和每场比赛48小时,将RHAE的得分提高到了51.66分. 我们没有看到进一步增加这些限制会有巨大的额外好处。

blocks.en: (ii) → \rightarrow (iii): Continuous conversation. We next allow the agent to interact with the environment through a continuous conversation. In the official implementation, each model request produces at most one environment action, and the interaction history is provided again with the next request. When this history exceeds the context limit, the oldest interactions are truncated, leaving only a sliding window of recent experience. Our setting allows multiple play calls within the same conversation and uses native context compaction when the context limit is reached. This preserves a compressed representation of earlier interactions, allowing information from past turns to remain available for subsequent reasoning.
blocks.zh: (二)~正中线(三):接连对话. 我们接下来允许特工通过持续的对话 与环境互动 在正式执行中,每个模型请求最多产生一个环境行动,交互历史再次被提供下一个请求. 当这个历史超过上下文限制时,最古老的相互作用被截断,只留下了最近经验的滑动窗口. 我们的设置允许在同一对话中多次播放调用,并在达到上下文限制时使用本地上下文收缩. 这保留了对早期互动的压缩表述,使得过去转向的信息仍然可供以后推理使用.

blocks.en: (iii) → \rightarrow (iv): Add notes. We introduce a minimal memory mechanism by adding two note files: GUIDE.md and WORKING.md . GUIDE.md stores reusable knowledge about the game across levels and sessions, while WORKING.md stores temporary state and plans for the current level. When the context approaches its limit, the agent writes a handoff summary in WORKING.md before resuming in a fresh context. These notes remain available across context boundaries, allowing the agent to carry forward its understanding of the game and its current state.
blocks.zh: (三) ~ 权(四): 添加笔记. 我们通过增加两个备注文件引入一个最小的内存机制: 准则和工作组 GuideDE.md 在工作的同时,在关卡和会话中存储游戏的可重复使用的知识. md存储临时状态和当前水平的计划. 当上下文接近其极限时,代理人会在"工作"中写出一份交割摘要. md 在新的背景下恢复之前。 这些笔记仍然可以跨上下文边界取用,使代理商能够继续推进其对游戏及其现状的理解.

blocks.en: (iv) → \rightarrow (vi): Add VISTA’s visual harness. Finally, we add VISTA’s key visual harness components: lossless visual memory, model-directed inspection ( inspect ), and exact pixel readout ( read_pixels ). The agent receives only the final frame after each action and can decide when to use these tools to revisit its visual memory as it reasons. These additions complete the VISTA harness.
blocks.zh: (四) ~ 恰到好处(六): 增加VISTA的视觉用具。 最后,我们添加了VISTA的关键视觉带组件:无损失视觉内存,模型定向检查(检查),以及精确的像素读取(读取_像素. 代理仅在每次动作后收到最终框架,并且可以决定何时使用这些工具来根据理由重温其视觉内存. 这些加法完成了VISTA带.

blocks.zh: A.3 评价计量

blocks.en: A.4 Agent Tools
blocks.zh: A.4 代理工具

blocks.en: The agent accesses tools only through structured function calls; plain text generated by the model cannot trigger tool execution. In Claude Code, we expose these tools through an MCP server and disable all built-in tools, preventing direct shell or file-system access. In Codex, we register the same tools directly with the app server. In both cases, the agent runs in a sandboxed container without access to environment credentials.
blocks.zh: 代理访问工具只能通过结构化函数调用;由模型生成的纯文本不能触发工具执行. 在克洛德代码中,我们通过一个MCP服务器来曝光这些工具并禁用所有内置工具,防止直接的 shell 或文件系统访问. 在 Codex 中,我们直接在应用程序服务器上注册同样的工具. 在这两种情况下,代理人都在一个沙箱集装箱中运行,无法获得环境证书。

blocks.en: A single host-side controller handles all tool calls. The controller maintains the environment connection, archived frames, GUIDE.md , and WORKING.md , and is the only component allowed to advance the game. It also enforces sequential interaction: a new play call is accepted only after the result of the previous action has been returned to the agent. Each returned image is labeled with its turn and frame index. Claude Code receives these images directly in the MCP result. In our Codex integration, tool outputs are text-only, and the controller provides the corresponding images separately as part of the same turn.
blocks.zh: 单一主机侧控制器处理所有工具调用. 控制器维护环境连接,存档帧,GUIDE.md,和World.md,是唯一允许推进游戏的组件. 它还强制进行相继互动:只有在之前动作的结果被还给代理后,才接受新的播放呼叫. 每个返回的图像都以其转折和帧索引作标签. Claude Code在MCP结果中直接接收到这些图像. 在我们的 Codex 集成中,工具输出只使用文本,控制器作为同转的部分单独提供相应的图像.

blocks.en: When the context is nearly full, the controller pauses normal tool use until the agent saves the state needed to continue. In Codex, the agent uses save_compact_checkpoint ; in Claude Code, a pre-compaction hook requests a write_working call. The agent then resumes in a fresh context containing GUIDE.md , WORKING.md , the action history, and the current frame.
blocks.zh: 当上下文接近满时,控制器会暂停普通工具的使用,直到代理机保存继续所需的状态. 在 Codex 中,代理机使用 save_compact_checkpoint;在 Claude 代码中,一个预compact hook 请求写入-工作呼叫. 代理商随后在包含"Guide.md","Working.md","动作历史"和"当前框架"的新上下文中恢复.

blocks.en: A.6 Human References
blocks.zh: A.6 人类参考资料

blocks.en: The organizers’ study involved 486 participants from the general public with diverse demographics. Participants were not selected for specialized training or skills [ ARC Prize Foundation, 2026b ] . Each game was tested by ten participants encountering it for the first time, without task-specific instructions. Testing took place in 90-minute sessions, with a soft time limit of 20 minutes and a hard cutoff of 30 minutes per game. A game was included only if at least two participants independently completed all levels. For each level, the official RHAE human baseline is the upper-median action count among first-time human players who completed that level [ ARC Prize Foundation, 2026a ] .
blocks.zh: 组织者的研究有486名公众参加,人口结构各异。 学员没有被选入专业培训或技能[ARC Prize Foundation, 2026b]. 每款游戏都经过十位参与者的测试,首次遇到,没有针对特定任务的指示. 测试在90分钟的会话中进行,软时间限制为20分钟,硬截取每场比赛30分钟. 只有当至少两名参与者独立完成所有关卡时,才包含一个游戏. 对于每个关卡,官方的RHAE人类基线是首次完成该关卡的人类玩家的上中线动作计数[ARC Prize Foundation, 2026a].

blocks.en: GameWorld reports results for two human players, both computer science graduate students, each of whom attempted all 170 tasks under the same budget of 100 actions per task as the agents [ Ouyang et al., 2026 ] . The novice player had no prior exposure to the games or tasks, while the expert player had studied the rules and practiced the controls beforehand. We use the novice player’s performance as our reference for first-time human play.
blocks.zh: GameWorld报道了两名人类玩家的成绩,两人都是计算机科学研究生,每人试图在每任务100个动作的同一项预算下完成全部170个任务[欧阳等,2026]. 新玩家之前没有接触游戏或任务,而专家玩家事先研究了规则并练习了控制. 我们用新玩家的表现作为我们第一次人类游戏的参考。

blocks.en: The benchmark’s human study recruited 106 participants through Prolific (mean age = 38.81) [ Ying et al., 2026 ] to play each game over a customized game interface. Each participant was randomly assigned ten games, and was given two minutes per game. We use the median score among participants who played each game as the human reference, normalized to 100 as described above.
blocks.zh: 该基准的人类研究通过Prolific(平均年龄=38.81)[Ying等,2026]招募了106名参与者,通过定制的游戏界面玩出每款游戏. 每位参与者被随机分配出10场比赛,每场比赛获得2分. 我们使用每场比赛参赛者的中位分作为人类参考,如上所描述的那样,将参赛人数正常化为100人.

blocks.en: BabyVision’s human evaluation involved 16 adult participants, each holding at least a bachelor’s degree, who completed all 388 questions [ Chen et al., 2026 ] . The reported human accuracy is 95.0% on the Maze subtype and 89.5% on Connect the Lines. We compute the human reference in Figure 11 , 92.3%, as the weighted mean of these subtype scores, using the 20 maze and 19 connecting-lines questions in our evaluation.
